observations: Both of the tester's standing observations are now closed: round 2's, that the refusal named only one path, and round 3's, that following symlinks was load-bearing and unpinned. No new observation this round.

The corrected write claim is the one I measured. jj reads the enclosing repository's configuration whenever it opens that repository, and writes into it only when a legacy .jj/repo/config.toml is there to migrate.
